# Sanad Project Codebase Index

> This file is the machine-readable index for LLMs and coding agents, conforming to https://llmstxt.org. It lists all active documentation and runtime system contracts.

Install: `fvm flutter run` for the UI Client, or `fvm dart run` for the Local Daemon.
Repo: https://github.com/EastStarAI/sanad-agent

## System Rules & Runtime Contracts

These files are mandatory execution contracts governing subdirectories. Always read them before editing files in their folders.

## Functional Features & Architecture Guides

- [خارطة محرك ومنطق الوكلاء](docs/agent_engine/MOC.md): فهرس وخارطة وثائق منطق وهندسة الوكلاء، سجل الأوامر النظامية، ومواصفات أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
- [Capability Runtime Architecture](docs/agent_engine/capability_runtime.md): Architecture of tool specifications, runtime catalog assembly, permissions, MCP, workspace/web services, skills, and platform tools.
- [Codex Responses Runtime Design](docs/agent_engine/codex_responses_runtime_design.md): تصميم codec وحالة الاستمرارية والبث والاستكمال لمحول Codex Responses في Sanad.
- [Context Compaction Engine Design](docs/agent_engine/context_compaction_design.md): Goal-preserving compaction engine contracts for pressure measurement, tail selection, summarization, and continuity validation.
- [LLM Adapter Runtime Contract](docs/agent_engine/llm_adapter_runtime_contract.md): عقد خيارات طلب النموذج، reasoning القابل للعرض، وحالة المزود اللازمة للاستكمال.
- [Sanad Delegate CLI Relay Specification](docs/agent_engine/sanad_delegate_relay.md): Machine contract for the native `sanad run` relay: argument/workspace security boundaries, versioned result and event artifacts, exit codes, and supervisor lifecycle with event-first intervention, queue control, cancellation, multi-run cursor watching, launch verification, mid-turn steering, task continuation, silence/dead-worker detection, and following a daemon-owned turn after its worker exits.
- [خارطة العمليات والأتمتة والنشر](docs/operations/MOC.md): فهرس وخارطة وثائق مسارات الأتمتة n8n، إعدادات الحاويات Docker، ومخططات النشر والتشغيل.
- [Brand Asset Generation and Platform Handoff](docs/operations/brand_asset_handoff.md): Canonical Sanad identity sources, generated platform assets, review-ready community deliverables, and live-surface ownership.
- [Code Signing Policy](docs/operations/code_signing_policy.md): Public artifact trust, protected signing, role separation, verification, and revocation policy for Sanad releases.
- [Community and Contribution Governance](docs/operations/community_governance.md): Operating model for Discord, Discussions, Issues, plans, pull requests, labels, protected review, and public-repository handoff.
- [Public CI Pipeline and Up-to-date Merges](docs/operations/continuous_integration.md): Job layout, cross-component path classification, test sharding, toolchain caching, required-check aggregate, slow-test evidence, and the protected up-to-date merge runbook for Public CI.
- [Develop Sanad Agent](docs/operations/developer_guide.md): Set up the public repository, run the Dart agent and Flutter client, test changes, and use isolated development runtimes.
- [Release, Signing, and Deployment Architecture](docs/operations/release_and_signing.md): The stable release pipeline, protected signing boundaries, artifact publication, and live-release handoff.
- [Install and Use Sanad Agent](docs/operations/user_guide.md): Install the Sanad client and agent, connect local or remote devices, configure providers, manage the service, and update Sanad.
- [خارطة متطلبات المنتج والأعمال](docs/product/MOC.md): فهرس وخارطة وثائق متطلبات المنتج، تجربة المستخدم، والأعمال الاستراتيجية للمشروع.
- [Client CLI and Background Operation](docs/product/client_cli_and_background_operation.md): User-facing behavior of the Sanad Client CLI relay, its permission modes, and background desktop operation.
- [Sanad Client Interface](docs/product/client_interface.md): Current user experience for devices, workspaces, conversations, attachments, View Image media, providers, permissions, and active agent interactions.
- [Conversation Fork UX](docs/product/conversation_fork_ux.md): Specification for forking a conversation from a durable final answer into an independent child session.
- [Conversation Navigation UX Spec](docs/product/conversation_navigation_ux_spec.md): UX specifications for conversation navigation destinations, history, deletion, and restart recovery.
- [Sanad Agent Features](docs/product/features.md): A user-facing guide to Sanad Agent's local, remote, provider, workspace, tool, and interaction capabilities.
- [Message Edit and Retry UX](docs/product/message_edit_retry_ux.md): Specification for inline edit, attachment restoration, and retry of the latest root user turn without deleting original history.
- [Sanad Agent Product Definition](docs/product/prd_sanad_agent.md): Current product scope, users, components, operating modes, capabilities, and boundaries.
- [Sanad Agent Identity and Scope](docs/product/project_identity_and_scope.md): Public identity, open-source scope, hosted-service boundary, and project naming.
- [Provider Account Usage Limits](docs/product/provider_account_usage_limits.md): Product behavior for instance-scoped provider usage windows, freshness, errors, and reset-credit controls.
- [Settings Hub](docs/product/settings_hub.md): Information architecture, scope semantics, and device-management UX for Sanad's unified Settings destination.
- [خارطة الجودة والدعم والصيانة](docs/qa_maintenance/MOC.md): فهرس وخارطة خطط الفحص وحالات الاختبار، أدلة حل المشكلات التقنية، ودعم التشغيل وصيانة المنصة.
- [Account Sessions and Devices QA](docs/qa_maintenance/account_sessions_devices_qa.md): Automated and interactive verification for account-scoped Client sessions, Agent devices, revocation, and Local event identity.
- [Agent Daemon Memory Retention QA](docs/qa_maintenance/agent_daemon_memory_qa.md): Regression matrix for streamed-text accumulation, the in-flight partial answer, the bounded history snapshot cache, and transport-scoped emitter release.
- [Agent State Database Maintenance QA](docs/qa_maintenance/agent_state_database_maintenance_qa.md): Readiness, idle batching, retention, and controlled-exit VACUUM verification for state.db.
- [Agent Turn Startup Performance QA](docs/qa_maintenance/agent_turn_startup_performance_qa.md): Regression matrix for metadata-only admission, atomic root-message append, revision-validated history reuse, and Windows long-session latency.
- [Agent Update Trust and Auto-Pairing QA](docs/qa_maintenance/agent_update_trust_and_auto_pairing_qa.md): Automated coverage and isolated live scenarios for typed update trust diagnostics, Desktop Client–Agent auto-pairing, and stopped-agent compatibility validation.
- [Bundled Product Skills QA](docs/qa_maintenance/bundled_product_skills_qa.md): Regression matrix for deterministic one-file skill embedding, SANAD_HOME installation, update, removal, customization safety, startup performance, and release artifacts.
- [Clarifying Question RTL QA](docs/qa_maintenance/clarifying_question_rtl_qa.md): Verification matrix for Arabic directionality and platform-aware multiline behavior in clarifying questions.
- [CLI Session Observability & Safe Intervention QA Matrix](docs/qa_maintenance/cli_session_observability_intervention_qa.md): QA validation matrix for daemon-backed CLI session observability, authoritative inspection, non-interactive live steering, runtime recovery retry, explicit question answering, ordinary tool permission decisions, cross-session safety, and scoped session termination.
- [Client CLI and Remote Relay QA](docs/qa_maintenance/client_cli_remote_relay_qa.md): Gate-linked pass/fail coverage for Client CLI host, permissions, sanad-client runner, and remote relay delegation.
- [Codex Prompt-Cache Affinity QA](docs/qa_maintenance/codex_prompt_cache_affinity_qa.md): Fixture coverage and owner-accepted live retention evidence for Codex Responses prompt_cache_key routing, GitHub exclusions, xAI raw-body support, and chatgpt.com affinity headers.
- [Community Governance QA](docs/qa_maintenance/community_governance_qa.md): Static and live verification matrix for labels, templates, contribution skills, protected CI, Discord routing, and public-repository governance.
- [Context Compaction QA](docs/qa_maintenance/context_compaction_qa.md): Automated and daemon-backed regression matrix for durable context compaction.
- [Conversation Cache and Draft Recovery QA](docs/qa_maintenance/conversation_cache_recovery_qa.md): QA scenarios for persistent conversation snapshots, draft acceptance, pagination recovery, cleanup, and lifecycle flush behavior.
- [Conversation Event Live/History Parity QA](docs/qa_maintenance/conversation_event_parity_qa.md): Focused verification for model-step segmentation, tool identity, opaque event IDs, and canonical history hydration.
- [Conversation Fork QA Matrix](docs/qa_maintenance/conversation_fork_qa.md): Quality assurance matrix for materialized conversation fork, lineage, and parent/child independence.
- [Conversation Navigation — QA Recovery Matrix](docs/qa_maintenance/conversation_navigation_recovery_matrix.md): QA verification and recovery scenarios for conversation navigation, history, and deletion.
- [Conversation Tool Groups and Compact Window QA](docs/qa_maintenance/conversation_tool_groups_and_compact_window_qa.md): Regression matrix for completed-tool grouping, nested and timeline follow, active-history completion, ask-user presentation, and desktop compact sizing.
- [Cross-Transport Delivery Presence QA](docs/qa_maintenance/cross_transport_delivery_presence_qa.md): Regression matrix for assertion-bound Local presence, Agent Cloud-egress gating, route transitions, and canonical event deduplication.
- [Desktop Authentication Exchange QA](docs/qa_maintenance/desktop_authentication_exchange_qa.md): Regression matrix for credential-free client-daemon authentication reconciliation.
- [Desktop Background Lifecycle and System Tray QA](docs/qa_maintenance/desktop_background_and_system_tray_qa.md): Gate-linked pass/fail coverage for close-to-hide background operation, tray projection, and platform scope.
- [Device Name Editing QA](docs/qa_maintenance/device_name_editing_qa.md): QA scenarios and test matrices for verifying device renaming.
- [Device Workspace Sidebar QA](docs/qa_maintenance/device_workspace_sidebar_qa.md): Focused QA coverage for the Plan 32c device-scoped sidebar, including pagination, cache-first rendering, responsive layout, accessibility, and live ordering.
- [Dictation Model Download Acceptance](docs/qa_maintenance/dictation_download_acceptance.md): Live acceptance for a dictation model install: bounded memory, install truth across a sheet reopen, a device switch, a socket close, and an interrupted resume.
- [External Workspace File Access QA](docs/qa_maintenance/external_workspace_file_access_qa.md): Regression matrix for permission-aware file and search access outside the selected workspace.
- [Flutter VM Driver CLI QA Matrix](docs/qa_maintenance/flutter_vm_driver_cli_qa.md): Static, managed-runtime, live interaction, and platform compatibility coverage for agent-driven Flutter control.
- [Jev Sanad UI Automation](docs/qa_maintenance/jev_sanad_ui_automation.md): Hybrid contract for Jev-assisted Sanad Client automation: the conversation runner, the guarded decision layer, escalation, and the kill criteria.
- [Linux Service Lifecycle QA](docs/qa_maintenance/linux_service_lifecycle_qa.md): Automated coverage and clean-host integration gates for the Linux Agent service lifecycle.
- [Live Context Usage Indicator QA](docs/qa_maintenance/live_context_usage_indicator_qa.md): Regression matrix for latest provider usage, cached-input visibility, tool-loop updates, and history restoration.
- [LM Studio Native Reasoning Discovery QA](docs/qa_maintenance/lm_studio_native_reasoning_discovery_qa.md): Focused matrix for bounded LM Studio native reasoning discovery from GET /api/v1/models into the declared descriptor and the actual Chat body.

- [Schedules Screen Live Acceptance](docs/qa_maintenance/schedules_screen_acceptance.md): Live acceptance record for the Task 139 Schedules list, detail page, run history, editor, and sidebar marker: the two local legs on the shipped code, the finding-by-finding fixes with re-live proof, the code-inspected cloud parity decision, and the obstacles worth keeping for future testers.

- [Windows-first Performance QA](docs/qa_maintenance/windows_first_performance_qa.md): Before/after metrics, request-count and rendering regressions, test-cost budgets, and final interactive acceptance.
- [Windows Release Clean-Machine Validation](docs/qa_maintenance/windows_release_clean_machine.md): Windows 11 release-gate evidence and reusable Windows clean-machine procedure for the unsigned Sanad 1.0.0 candidate.
- [Remote Workspace Folder Management QA](docs/qa_maintenance/workspace_folder_management_qa.md): Regression matrix for the confined remote workspace picker, managed-root confinement, and preserved local native picker behavior.
- [Workspace Identity and Change Path QA](docs/qa_maintenance/workspace_identity_relocation_qa.md): Regression coverage for UUID migration, missing folders, rename, Change Path, cache reconciliation, scoped Settings routing, and live remote Change Path tooling notes.
- [خارطة المعمارية والرمز التقني](docs/technical/MOC.md): فهرس وخارطة وثائق المعمارية البرمجية، تصميم قواعد البيانات، وواجهات برمجة التطبيقات.
- [Agent Daemon Memory Retention](docs/technical/agent_daemon_memory.md): What the long-running sanad-agent daemon retains per session and turn, the release or bound that owns each, the JIT-versus-AOT baseline, and how to measure it.
- [مواصفات قاعدة البيانات المحلية للوكيل](docs/technical/agent_database_schema.md): تصميم جداول قاعدة البيانات المحلية (SQLite - state.db) التابعة للوكيل sanad-agent لحفظ الجلسات وتفاصيل التعليق.
- [Agent Interface and Runtime Architecture](docs/technical/agent_interface_runtime.md): Architecture of gateway routing, active-run orchestration, Sanad protocol translation, recovery, and local/cloud platform adapters.
- [معمارية تشغيل الوكيل المحلي](docs/technical/agent_runtime.md): تصميم محرك تشغيل الوكيل (sanad-agent) وتركيب موجه النظام (System Prompt) للـ KV-Cache والتأمين الأمني.
- [Background Terminal Task Runtime](docs/technical/background_terminal_task_runtime.md): العقد التقني للمهام الطرفية الخلفية المملوكة، والنقل الذري من الجولة، والـPTY والمخرجات، والإيقاظ، والتفاعل الآمن، والتعافي.
- [Bound Client and Agent Authentication](docs/technical/client_authentication.md): PKCE-bound Flutter login and P-256-bound Headless Agent authorization through Sanad Portal.
- [Client Conversation Cache Schema](docs/technical/client_conversation_cache_schema.md): Ownership, persistence schema, pagination rules, draft correlation, and stable consumer APIs for the Flutter conversation cache.
- [Client Conversation Navigation Runtime](docs/technical/client_conversation_navigation.md): Technical design for device-scoped sidebar projection, atomic history swaps, deletion fallback, and route synchronization.
- [Client Local Daemon Control](docs/technical/client_local_daemon_control.md): Architecture for source and standalone daemon lifecycle control from the Flutter desktop client.
- [Client Multilingual Interface (English / Arabic)](docs/technical/client_multilanguage.md): English/Arabic localization architecture, `gen_l10n` scaffolding, locale ownership (`LocaleCubit`), RTL rules, and the remaining-string coverage report.
- [بروتوكولات الاتصال ونظام نقل الأحداث](docs/technical/communication_protocols.md): توثيق بروتوكول Socket.IO ونقل الأحداث والمهام وطلبات التعليق (Suspension) مع العميل.
- [Context Compaction Architecture](docs/technical/context_compaction.md): Ownership boundaries, vocabulary, and wire-safety rules for durable goal-preserving context compaction (Plan 53).
- [CONTEXT_WINDOW_RESOLUTION](docs/technical/context_window_resolution.md): Technical specification for context_window_resolution.
- [مواصفات نظام التصميم والمكونات المرئية للمشاريع](docs/technical/design_system.md): توثيق شامل للألوان، الخطوط، الهيكل البنائي والواجهات التفاعلية المشتركة لمشاريع Sanad (التطبيق الرئيسي، صفحة الهبوط، ولوحة التحكم).
- [Desktop Authentication Exchange](docs/technical/desktop_authentication_exchange.md): Credential-free live authentication reconciliation between a native Flutter client and its local Dart daemon.
- [Desktop Background Lifecycle, System Tray, and OS Notifications](docs/technical/desktop_background_and_system_tray.md): Close-to-hide background persistence, macOS/Windows system tray projection, recent conversations, Agent/CLI lifecycle controls, and local desktop OS notifications.
- [Device Runtime Settings Protocol](docs/technical/device_runtime_settings_protocol.md): Unified local/cloud protocol commands, validation, persistence, and secret-handling rules for device settings.
- [Dictation Transport Protocol](docs/technical/dictation_transport_protocol.md): Authoritative, source-neutral wire contract for dictation: channel-neutral daemon vocabulary, hosted relay envelopes, binary PCM framing, session/request/route/seq identity, origin-only delivery, admission and lifecycle limits, capability schema, and legacy voice origin correlation.
- [Execution Trust and Permission Authority](docs/technical/execution_trust_and_permission_authority.md): Transport-derived command authority, daemon-private workspace policy, child-process environment policy, Direct/Protected backends, host discovery, project .env redaction, the Agent secret vault, and user secrets.
- [Flutter VM Driver CLI Architecture](docs/technical/flutter_vm_driver_cli.md): Driver-enabled Client instrumentation, standalone CLI boundaries, deterministic UI selectors, and VM Service safety.
- [Hosted Services Boundary](docs/technical/hosted_services_boundary.md): Ownership and compatibility boundary between the open-source Sanad Agent clients and EastStar AI hosted services.
- [Linux Agent Service Lifecycle](docs/technical/linux_service_lifecycle.md): Technical contract for Linux service selection, ownership, installation transactions, and lifecycle reporting.
- [Local Dictation](docs/technical/local_dictation.md): In-process speech-to-text dictation: ownership boundary, transport, event contract, model catalog and lifecycle, platform gate.
- [MCP Server Configuration, Secrets, and Inspection](docs/technical/mcp_server_configuration.md): Daemon-owned MCP configuration, secret handling, inspection, OAuth, import/export, and runtime isolation architecture.
- [Message Turn Replay Protocol](docs/technical/message_turn_replay_protocol.md): Technical specification for latest-root-turn replay with stable identity, soft rewind, and authoritative idle admission.
- [Multimodal Tool Results and View Image](docs/technical/multimodal_tool_results_and_view_image.md): Provider-neutral tool results, secure user attachments, tool-chosen image inspection, conversation media, durability, and binary-safety contract.
- [Native Dictation Runtime Platforms](docs/technical/native_stt_runtime_platforms.md): Platform tag, directory layout, portable instruction-set baseline, verification rules, and release staging for the in-process whisper.cpp and sherpa-onnx dictation runtimes, including macOS Intel (x64) and the whisper-only Linux arm64 build.
- [بروتوكول مزودي نماذج اللغة](docs/technical/provider_protocol.md): بروتوكول إعداد مزودي LLM والمصادقة والتخزين واختيار النموذج في Sanad Agent.
- [Public Client Endpoint Configuration](docs/technical/public_client_endpoint_configuration.md): Production and local endpoint defaults plus explicit private Development and Staging build-time injection.
- [Reasoning, Thoughts, and Final Answer Separation](docs/technical/reasoning_thoughts_separation.md): Protocol, adapter normalization, history, and state for assistant surfaces. Streaming text shares the final-answer Markdown look; provider reasoning is a transient live-only row never rebuilt from history.
- [Remote CLI Relay Protocol](docs/technical/remote_cli_relay_protocol.md): Typed protocol commands, streamed output, execution seam, session-scoped approval grammar, and boundaries for remote Sanad CLI relay.
- [Remote Device Control Protocol](docs/technical/remote_device_control_protocol.md): Typed commands, admission errors, and correlation rules for remote Agent update, restart, workspaces, and MCP.
- [Remote Device Control Threat Model](docs/technical/remote_device_control_threat_model.md): Trust boundaries, hosted ownership evidence, MCP payload handling, managed workspace roots, and gate-linked pass/fail tests for Task 82.
- [Run Cancellation and Process Ownership](docs/technical/run_cancellation_and_process_ownership.md): العقد التقني لإلغاء جولة الوكيل إلغاءً محدود الزمن، ومقاطعة المزود والأداة، وامتلاك شجرة العمليات، وتثبيت نتيجة نهائية متطابقة حيًا وتاريخيًا.
- [Sanad CLI Architecture](docs/technical/sanad_cli_architecture.md): Attached and in-process transports, startup vault order, prompt ownership and code-identity authorization failures, the explicit `sanad vault authorize` grant, deferred vault opening, runtime ownership, automation output, non-interactive session steering and runtime recovery retry, cancellation, and test-isolation contracts.
- [sanad-dev Runtime Ownership](docs/technical/sanad_dev_runtime_ownership.md): Managed launcher leases, workspace/client ownership, clone isolation, continuous source handoff, agent supervision and identity-verified restart, the reset, apply, refresh, `cli`, status, and doctor runtime tooling, and the read-only `inventory` projection.
- [Schedule Control Protocol](docs/technical/schedule_control_protocol.md): Unified local/cloud protocol commands, envelopes, projections, error codes, change broadcasts, failure surfacing, and the Client data client, cubit, and route contract for device-owner schedule control.
- [User Secret Management Protocol](docs/technical/secret_management_protocol.md): Unified local/cloud protocol commands, envelopes, error codes, and redaction invariants for device-owner user secret management.
- [Session Fork Protocol](docs/technical/session_fork_protocol.md): Daemon-authoritative materialized conversation fork with lineage, atomic copy, and idle child admission.
- [Release and Update Architecture](docs/technical/update_architecture.md): The shared release manifest and the update ownership of the Sanad agent and client on every runtime.
- [Local Gateway and Sanad Home Protection](docs/technical/user_data_protection_and_minimization.md): Authentication, origin enforcement, filesystem ownership, secure startup, and runtime isolation for local Sanad data.
- [Experimental Realtime Voice](docs/technical/voice_streaming.md): Current experimental Gemini Realtime voice path, transports, audio format, interruption behavior, and release boundaries.
- [Web Push and Installable Web Delivery](docs/technical/web_push_delivery.md): Owned service worker and its offline consequences, explicit browser permission and account-bound subscription lifecycle, foreground authority, click-through and action limits, relay registration contract, and the iOS home-screen install requirement.
- [Web Search Runtime](docs/technical/web_search_runtime.md): Daemon-owned web search providers, DuckDuckGo redirect normalization, fallback behavior, and SSRF filtering.
